name: MOLA (Mars Orbiter Laser Altimeter)
measures: Global topographic elevation and planetary radii (MEGDR 4-128 ppd)

name: CTX (Context Camera)
measures: 30 km-wide swath global surface imagery (~5-6 m/px)

name: HiRISE (High Resolution Imaging Science Experiment)
measures: Sub-meter visible/NIR imagery and 1 m stereo DTMs

name: CRISM (Compact Reconnaissance Imaging Spectrometer for Mars)
measures: Visible-NIR (0.36-3.92 um) mineralogical mapping (clays, carbonates, sulfates)

name: THEMIS (Thermal Emission Imaging System)
measures: Day/night thermal infrared mosaics for thermal inertia and surface composition

name: SHARAD (Shallow Radar)
measures: Subsurface radar sounding (20 MHz) detecting buried ice sheets up to ~1 km depth

name: MARSIS (Mars Advanced Radar for Subsurface and Ionosphere Sounding)
measures: Low-frequency (1.8-5 MHz) deep subsurface sounding of polar layered deposits

name: OMEGA (Observatoire pour la Mineralogie, l'Eau, les Glaces et l'Activite)
measures: Global visible-NIR mapping of hydrated minerals, sulfates, and surface ice

name: HRSC (High Resolution Stereo Camera)
measures: Regional stereo DTMs and true-color orbital mosaics

name: MARCI (Mars Color Imager)
measures: Daily global weather, dust storm fronts, and ozone monitoring

name: RAD (Radiation Assessment Detector)
measures: Surface GCR (~0.67 mSv/sol baseline) and SEP dose rates in Gale crater
src: SwRI / DLR / NASA JPL (Hassler et al. 2014)

name: Mastcam-Z
measures: High-resolution stereo color panoramas and multispectral outcrop imaging

name: SEIS (Seismic Experiment for Interior Structure)
measures: Marsquake detection, crustal thickness, and mantle/core structure
